subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the open fork PR, or sponsor a narrow same-repository fix for the active direct Anthropic transport?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open conflicting fork PR already uses closing syntax and the closed same-repository attempts targeted older paths; automation should not queue a competing repair while maintainer routing is explicitly pending.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow same-repository fix
options.body: Land a focused current-main patch in `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` plus regression coverage for OAuth with model-level `anthropic-beta`; close or ignore the stale fork candidate afterward.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to bring the fork work into the main repository, update it for the active direct transport path, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for fork author update
options.body: Keep this issue open but do not start a new repair lane until the fork PR is rebased and retargeted into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Land a focused current-main patch in `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` plus regression coverage for OAuth with model-level `anthropic-beta`; close or ignore the stale fork candidate afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the active direct Anthropic transport and has the strongest history on the implicated transport/test surface.
